'''2022 MPC Top 8 Mike Kessling LS Yoda Communing''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mike Kessling]] at [[2022 Match Play Championship]] (Top 8).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Mike Kessling]]
* '''Event:''' [[2022 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Stage:''' Top 8
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Communing|V16-L-communing.gif}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|I Am Part Of The Living Force|V16-L-iampartofthelivingforce.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Communing Kessling LS 2022 MPC.txt |Download]]
